title: A brick wall closes 1808 Prairie's yard on the alley
items: Behind 1808 Prairie, the Glessner courtyard wall now turns the corner at the alley gate and runs about 2.5 m south along the alley, as the 1963 survey drawing shows. Before, it stopped dead at the gatepost.
It is built in 1808's own buff brick under a stone coping, at the courtyard wall's height. No drawing or photograph gives that height, so the Confidence view marks the wall as reconstructed.
